property_summary: For any admissible amount>0 sent to a receiver whose receive() does nontrivial storage work (needs more than transfer's 2300 gas stipend), sendTo must revert; the mutant's unchecked low-level call forwards all gas, so the receive succeeds and sendTo completes, violating the rule.
